authority_note: Q01-Q54 originate in the answered owner questionnaire. D01 scope/governance is approved and recorded in ADR-010; other V2 implementation details, formulas, phase assignments, and D02-D14 remain proposals unless separately approved.

classification_legend.VERIFIED: Current implementation has sufficient current static or test evidence for the stated requirement.
classification_legend.PARTIAL: Some relevant implementation exists but the full requirement is not met.
classification_legend.MISSING: The reviewed routes, models, migrations, screens, and tests provide sufficient evidence that the capability is absent.
classification_legend.UNVERIFIED: The current environment or evidence cannot establish that the requirement is met or absent.
classification_legend.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The V2 plan explicitly defers the capability from the internal ERP release.

E-AUTH.note: Session password authentication, organization membership scoping, fixed editor/reader roles, explicit CSRF enforcement, and a login throttle are present.

E-MASTER.note: Shared organization-scoped parties, party roles, products, units, warehouses, locations, and Rial price lists exist.

E-CRM.note: P05 supports leads, dated follow-ups, quotes, exact Toman snapshots, confirmation, and conversion to sales orders.

E-STOCK.note: P06 maintains organization-scoped stock operations, movements, balances, reservations, and explicit locking.

E-FULFILL.note: P07 provides reserved order-line delivery, remainder cancellation, and stock issue trace.

E-PURCHASE.note: P08 implements purchase requests, separate approval, supplier orders, exact Rial snapshots, and receipts.

E-LEDGER.note: P09 supports manual whole-Rial books, periods, journals, balanced posting, idempotency, closure, and append-only reversal.

E-SETTLEMENT.note: P10 is accepted locally only for the synthetic invoice and settlement paths in ADR-008; live posting is not approved.

E-REPORTING.note: P11 provides read-only dashboard metrics, drill-downs, selected-book financial reporting, and synthetic walkthrough evidence.

E-WORK.note: P12 provides projects, assigned tasks, three task statuses, comments, a local due-reminder inbox, and unique P08 purchase-line cost links.

E-ADMIN.note: P13 provides separately granted role-manager authority, membership-role history, create-only CSV/XLSX party import, and filtered CSV party export.

tests: Historical browser evidence in docs/UI_DESIGN.md P01-P13 sections; not current P14 evidence.
E-UI.note: Static review only. Current P14 browser capture was blocked by loopback timeouts; historical screenshots were not reused as current audit evidence.

E-ENV.note: The test guard requires testing/mariadb/127.0.0.1/erp_test/erp_test and matching DB_PORT/DB_FORWARD_PORT, rejecting URL and socket overrides.

E-ABSENCE.note: Absence findings use the full route, migration, model, screen, and test inventories plus a cross-repository search for contracts, installments, payroll, time tracking, HR, documents, notifications, global search, service catalogs, project phases, capacity, profitability, backup, and restore. One missing name in one file was never used as the sole basis.

E-GOV.note: P14 AC-P14-04 explicitly requires owner approval; the V2 document is untracked and is not itself approval.

requirements.summary: Configurable service catalog, categories, and multi-service projects

requirements.summary: Five initial users, 100 staff, 10,000 customer accounts, and about 200 concurrent users
requirements.current_state: The local app and MariaDB are available, but no load test or scaled environment was run; concurrency and capacity are not established.

requirements.summary: Internal ERP first; customer portal later and kept separate/disabled
requirements.current_state: The current web and API routes require internal authentication and active organization membership; no customer portal exists, as planned for later phases.

requirements.current_state: P04 stores parties and customer/supplier roles; no separate representative/contact model or customer document/PII policy was identified.

requirements.summary: Structured contract record and signed contract document

requirements.summary: Contract generation from templates, approval, and signed-version tracking

requirements.current_state: P12 has projects and tasks but no persisted phase hierarchy or Markdown masterplan import/version model.

requirements.summary: Project-manager authority and team-member work reports

requirements.summary: Timer/manual time logs, approval, and hourly cost

requirements.summary: Quality/deadline performance, approved work, and lessons learned

requirements.current_state: No employee, payroll, compensation, bonus, or staff-settlement model or route was found.

requirements.summary: Prioritize project, financial control, and task workflows before daily use
